stem: To make pink paint, Sylvia mixes 7 cups of white paint to every 3 cups of red paint. Which table shows possible values of w, the number of cups of white paint Sylvia uses, and r, the number of cups of red paint?

options.label: A
options.text:
White Paint, w (cups)    7    49    343    2,401
Red Paint, r (cups)     3     9     27      81

options.label: B
options.text:
White Paint, w (cups)    7    8    9    10
Red Paint, r (cups)      3    4    5     6

options.label: C
options.text:
White Paint, w (cups)    7    14    21    28
Red Paint, r (cups)      3     6     9    12

options.label: D
options.text:
White Paint, w (cups)    7    6    5    4
Red Paint, r (cups)      3    4    5    6

Table B with values for white paint: 7, 8, 9, 10 and red paint: 3, 4, 5, 6
